message.content:
You're working on Nxeon, a hosting platform (Next.js/TypeScript/Prisma/Postgres). `/opt/nxeon` is production (git, origin/main). `/opt/nxeon-staging` is a separate staging checkout with its own DB, used for verification.

## The task

A background task chip flagged (from an earlier audit of `components/AuthForms.tsx`) that the login form's Email and Password `<label>` elements aren't associated with their inputs — no `htmlFor`/`id` pair. This is a real, small accessibility defect: a screen reader announces the input with no name, and clicking the label text doesn't focus the input.

## What to do

1. Read `components/AuthForms.tsx` fully. Find every `<label>`/`<input>` pair across the login AND register forms (check both — the same defect likely repeats) that lacks a proper `htmlFor`/`id` association.
2. Fix each one: give the input a stable, unique `id` and set the label's `htmlFor` to match. Watch for:
   - Duplicate `id`s if the same form component is used more than once on a page (e.g., a modal + a full-page version) — make ids derive from a prop if the component is reused, or confirm it's only ever rendered once per page.
   - Any other form on the site sharing this same component (grep for where `AuthForms.tsx`'s exports are imported) so you fix it everywhere it's used, not just on `/login`.
3. While you're in there, do a quick pass for any other obvious, easy accessibility gaps in the SAME file (missing `autoComplete` attributes on email/password/name fields, missing `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` on an error message tied to a field) — but keep this tight and don't scope-creep into a full accessibility audit of the whole site. If you notice something bigger, note it in your report instead of fixing it.

## Verification
1. Baseline: `cd /opt/nxeon && npm test 2>&1 | grep "^not ok"` before changes (should be 34 pre-existing failures, all pricing/proration/auth-flavored — none about accessibility).
2. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean after.
3. `npm test` failure set identical to baseline after.
4. Commit ending in:
   ```

   Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
   ```
   `git push origin main` — retry once after 2s on "cannot lock ref" (transient, known issue, other work lands on main concurrently).
5. Deploy to staging: `bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh main`. Verify on `https://staging.nxeon.cloud/login` with Playwright (`/opt/nxeon-staging/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs`) that clicking the "Email" label text actually focuses the email input (and same for password) — a real behavioral test, not just reading the JSX.

## Hard constraints
- Do NOT run `scripts/promote-production.sh` — staging only.
- Don't run `npm run build` inside `/opt/nxeon` itself.

## Final report
What you fixed, where, verification results, and anything else you noticed but left alone.

# Deploy a ref (default: main from /opt/nxeon) to the staging environment.

set -euo pipefail
REF="${1:-main}"
cd /opt/nxeon-staging

echo "==> Syncing staging to $REF"
git fetch origin
git reset --hard "origin/$REF"

echo "==> Installing dependencies"
npm install --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -1

echo "==> Applying database schema"
npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss 2>&1 | tail -2
npm run db:seed 2>&1 | tail -2 || true

echo "==> Building"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4

# Web runs as the unprivileged 'nxeon' user. Only .next needs to be writable by
# it (Next cache); the rest stays root-owned and world-readable, and systemd
# injects .env as root. Do NOT chown the whole tree (breaks root git on .git).
echo "==> Fixing .next ownership for non-root web"
chown -R nxeon:nxeon /opt/nxeon-staging/.next 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 600 /opt/nxeon-staging/.env 2>/dev/null || true

echo "==> Restarting staging services"
systemctl restart nxeon-staging-web nxeon-staging-worker

Everything is clean and confirmed. Final summary below.

## Summary

**Fixed:** `/opt/nxeon/components/AuthForms.tsx` — 5 `<label>`/`<input>` pairs across `LoginForm` and `RegisterForm` lacked `htmlFor`/`id` association:

- `LoginForm`: Email (`login-email`), Password via `PasswordField` (`login-password`), 2FA code (`login-2fa-code`)
- `RegisterForm`: Name (`register-name`), Email (`register-email`), Password via `PasswordField` (`register-password`)

`PasswordField` (shared between both forms) gained a new `id` prop (default `"password"`) so each call site passes a distinct id — this preempts future id collisions if both forms were ever rendered on one page (currently they aren't; confirmed via grep that `LoginForm`/`RegisterForm` are each imported and rendered exactly once, in `app/login/page.tsx` and `app/register/page.tsx` respectively — the `TicketForms.tsx` hit was just a code comment referencing this file, not an import).

**Small extra a11y fix in the same file:** added `role="alert"` to `ErrorBox` so form-level errors (invalid credentials, validation failures) get announced by screen readers automatically instead of silently appearing.

**Not touched (left for a separate pass, to avoid scope creep):** the required/recommended password-rule checklist (`<ul>` of ✓/○ items) has no `aria-live` region, so a screen reader user typing a password won't hear rule status update in real time — that's a bigger, more involved fix (needs `aria-live="polite"`, probably `aria-atomic` and re-thinking how much gets re-announced per keystroke) and wasn't part of the flagged defect.

**Verification:**
- Baseline `npm test` (original file, via git stash): 34 `not ok` failures.
- After fix: 34 `not ok` failures, and the failing test names are byte-identical to baseline (diffed).
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean, no errors.
- Committed as `ac83914` on `main`, pushed to `origin/main` (no lock-ref retry needed).
- Deployed to staging via `scripts/deploy-staging.sh main` (first attempt hit a transient failure from concurrent pushes landing mid-deploy — unrelated `symlink` build glitch — second run succeeded cleanly and picked up a later main HEAD that still contains my commit, confirmed via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`).
- Playwright against `https://staging.nxeon.cloud/login` and `/register`: clicking the "Email", "Password" (login), "Name", "Email", "Password" (register) label text focuses the corresponding input in every case — all 5 checks passed.

No other files were modified. Did not run `promote-production.sh` or `npm run build` in `/opt/nxeon`.
